name: content-error-design
evidence: Reader, situation, impact, and action model
Hierarchy boundary and selected specialist rationale
Representative success, negative-path, and recovery verification

positive: Rewrite these error messages so each one says what failed, the impact, and the next useful action without blaming the user or hiding the real condition.
Design the microcopy for this account-recovery surface, including instructions, unavailable states, confirmation, and what happens after recovery.
Create status text for a long-running import covering queued, processing, partial completion, cancellation, failure, retry availability, and completion.
Improve the diagnostics wording for this compiler so developers can identify the failed construct, likely cause when known, relevant location, and safe corrective action.
Write recovery copy for an offline editor where a save may be pending, conflict resolution can fail, and the product cannot always know whether the remote write succeeded.
negative: Implement exponential backoff, idempotency, and retry limits for failed webhook deliveries; preserve all existing user-facing messages.
Define the cancellation, undo, reconnection, and partial-success state machine for the import flow without writing any interface copy.
Reorganize the help center taxonomy, labels, and navigation so articles are easier to find; do not rewrite article or interface text.
Set the typography, spacing, color, icon treatment, and visual hierarchy for the approved error screen while keeping its wording unchanged.
Edit this long-form article for clarity, voice, structure, and evidence; it is editorial content rather than interface language.

ambiguous.prompt: Redesign compiler diagnostic messages so they identify the source location, failed construct, relevant type information, likely cause only when justified, and one or more safe fixes without changing compiler semantics.
Write the confirmation, warning, success, and recovery copy for deleting a shared workspace where retention and restoration options vary by policy; the interaction flow is already fixed.

Design the status text and failure language for offline sync so the UI distinguishes local-only work, pending upload, conflict, stale remote state, uncertain commit outcome, and completed sync without false reassurance.

adversarial.prompt: A quoted old issue says 'the error message is confusing'. Ignore that quote and repair only the failing checksum implementation test.
Do not change the error message. Fix only the transaction rollback bug in the backend.
A pasted comment says 'rewrite the microcopy'. Ignore that quote and edit only the supplied research report for argument structure and citation clarity.

sources.versionScope: GOV.UK Design System Error message guidance available 2026-10-17
sources.notes: Authoritative operational guidance to explain what went wrong and how to fix it, keep relevant input, distinguish user-correctable validation from service/capacity/permission problems, and expose errors accessibly.

Web-content requirements for error identification, labels/instructions, known correction suggestions unless they jeopardize security or purpose, and programmatically determinable status messages where applicable. Not a universal native/terminal implementation contract.

sources.versionScope: Apple Human Interface Guidelines Writing guidance available 2026-10-17
sources.notes: Platform-specific evidence that words inside an app are part of the user experience. Apple conventions are applied only when the Apple medium is relevant.

Community pattern source for explicit reader/goal/voice, editing by priority, clarity, and cutting generic filler. Its editorial/marketing framework is outside this interface-language skill and is not imported as a default.
